flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login then log in with email {{global.account1_email}} and password {{secrets.user.account1_password}}.
Open the appointment booking page.
Book an appointment for the first patient in the patient list on tomorrow's date at 10:00 and submit.

Open the appointment booking page again.
Book an appointment for the second patient in the patient list on tomorrow's date at 10:00 and submit.
Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'.
Verify that the second booking was refused with a message that the 10:00 slot tomorrow is already taken.
Get what the page shows after the second booking and save as {{what_happened}}.

verdict.root_cause: The booking page allowed another appointment at a time that was already listed for the same patient and date. It redirected back to the patient page rather than showing that the slot was unavailable.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause the outcome. It opened the second patient, used the requested date and 10:00 time, and submitted the form. The patient page already showed a 14 Nov 2026 10:00 appointment before submission, and the result showed an additional 10:00 appointment after submission.
verdict.bug_title: Appointment booking accepts an already occupied time slot
verdict.suggestion: Prevent submission when the selected patient already has an appointment at that date and time, and show a clear message that the 10:00 slot is already taken.
